benchmark_scope: 24 scalar plus owner-approved 39 representative RGB cases, each four alternating blocks of five warm-ups and five observations

limitations: Physical Watch excluded and unexecuted; representative physical iPhone/iPad also unavailable.
Requested heap, observed stack and process RSS have different scopes. Unknown fields are not zero.
Performance ratios retain case-level paired samples and workstation conditions; no regression waiver.
The 68a286d powered results are intermediate. Final production measurements use the powered-value directory.
Native runtime evidence requires an exact 26.0 arm64 guest success report; download or build alone is not a pass.
